description: IIS with script to configure it as the monitor's fast download web server.

configFiles.template:
Windows Container

It works — natively.

This page is served by Microsoft IIS running in a native Windows container (Server Core LTSC 2025, process isolation), over HTTP and HTTPS with a self-signed certificate.

Deployed and managed by TCAdmin V3.

Web serverIIS 10
Base imageservercore/iis
Isolationprocess

📦 Fast Downloads (FastDL)

This server can act as a Fast Download host, serving game files from the /FastDL/ path over HTTPS.

To turn it on, open this service in the TCAdmin control panel and run the Enable Fast Downloads script. It points this server's Fast Download storage here and enables FastDL.

Fast Downloads must also be enabled and configured for each individual game before its services will mirror and serve their files here.

Edit wwwroot/index.html in the file manager to replace this page.

script.name: IIS Windows - strip HostIP for WinNAT (interim)
Configure IIS HTTPS (self-signed cert + HTTPS binding)
script.description: Generates a self-signed certificate, binds it to IIS on :443 inside the container, and adds a wildcard MIME map so Fast Download payloads are served. Runs on every container start.

script.name: Enable Fast Downloads
script.description: Points this server's Fast Download storage at {service}/wwwroot/FastDL (created if missing) and serves it over HTTPS.

script.name: Disable Fast Downloads on delete
script.description: On service delete, clears this server's Fast Download storage/URL if it still pointed at this service.
